Keep bigger undertakings like job searches or trip planning organized with Projects.

Consider it handled by Hark Handoff

Hark’s computer use agent, Handoff, can use the internet just like you would. It can build websites, do research, place orders, make slides, you name it. All from its own secure computer with a full browser that’s individual to you.
Rest assured it's Secured by hark

Secured by hark has end-to-end encryption so your data stays safe. You’ll want to connect accounts, save logins, and make payments on Hark. That’s a lot of info you’re trusting us with. Think of this as a vault that absolutely no person has access to.
Plus, Hark checks in with you before doing something that requires your approval.

Hark’s Action Buttons are the to-do list you’ve always dreamed of. Hark suggests and prioritizes these based on what it knows you have on your plate. All you have to do is click on it and Hark will perform that action from start to finish.
Create your own customized Panels to stay on top of whatever you like. All you do is describe what you want and Hark will build mini-apps completely tailored to you.
You can ask your Panels questions to dig deeper into their data, unlocking even more from services you already use like Strava, Spotify, and Venmo.

limitations: Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
